reviews.text: I can only thank the entire team! From the reception and WhatsApp support to the veterinarians, they were all super professional, attentive, careful, and above all, trustworthy! Fast service, pleasant environment, very fair prices, and impeccable follow-up, including post-surgery, always sending photos and updates. It exceeded my expectations! I recommend them without hesitation! ❤️

Words can't describe the care, love, and attention this team gave my peanut brittle.

A wonderful clinic with competent and compassionate professionals.
You can trust them without a doubt or hesitation!

A caring team, with good judgment and without exploiting the vulnerability of the animal and its owner. Well-equipped and well-located hospital. Attached is a picture of my pet being cared for by the staff there.

I was very satisfied with the service at the clinic. Everyone was very caring and attentive to me and my cat, Bob.

I will continue his treatment as he is unwell and will also bring my other four-legged children.

I highly recommend it!!!

Thank you, Dr. Gabriel, Dr. Lucas, Rosana, and the entire team, for the warm welcome.

Our kitten Frida was hospitalized a week ago. We discovered she had kidney stones. We had an operation performed by Dr. Rafael, which was a success. Dr. Davi and Dr. Letícia, Amanda, and Gisele were of paramount importance to the diagnosis, in addition to the brilliant team that accompanied her during this hospitalization. There were several ups and downs; she had surgery, a CT scan, a blood transfusion, but in the end, we were successful. She was a warrior, and together with the medical team, the success was total.
We thank everyone who took care of our little one. Dr. Milena and Juliana from the inpatient unit, Dr. Orlando from the ICU, Rosana Aline from Reception, and all the nurses Carol, Felipe, and all the others whose names I forgot, but we thank them from the bottom of our hearts. We continue with the treatment at home. The most important thing was the professionalism and love that all the professionals at Paulistano had for our family and kitten.

I want to express our satisfaction with the service at the entire veterinary hospital. From the reception to the medical team, everyone was excellent, very attentive, polite, and caring towards us and our little dog.

I would especially like to thank Dr. Matheus Victor for his care and attention during our little one's delivery.

We were very happy to find such a dedicated, humane, and professional team. Our animals are part of our family, and being able to count on professionals who treat them with so much affection makes all the difference.

Congratulations to the entire team for the excellent work! I wholeheartedly recommend them! ❤️🐾🙏
The place has good service, the pet is neutered and recovers very well. In addition, I appreciated the care they show the animals.

Excellent professionals. I received excellent service when I needed to take my cat in, without having any idea what was happening to him.

Very attentive and helpful!

I would like to thank the entire team for all the care, support, affection, and help.
Lolla was transferred in critical condition, and unfortunately, she went to shine in heaven alongside the angels.
Despite this, the love they had for her is admirable; it's the affection of someone who was truly born with this mission!
Thank you for taking care of our angel!

I am immensely grateful to the entire team. The receptionists, the veterinarians, the nurses… Incredible professionals, with completely humane care, who, in addition to welcoming our animals, also welcome the owners, providing security, respect, showing that they are on our side and honoring that trust.

In August, I took Boru, my cat, for treatment.

From the beginning, they were very frank with me, presenting the best solutions for her case in a way that wouldn't cost me more than necessary. They showed that they truly take the health and well-being of animals seriously.

They closely monitored her case and were super respectful during her hospitalization, sending me daily updates on how she was doing. After her discharge, they instructed me on the best way to care for her at home.

Gratitude to everyone for helping with Boru's health, so that she continues to live and have a good quality of life.
It was an excellent experience with the clinic for my kitten's neutering; they were super attentive throughout the entire process.

I want to express my gratitude to the entire team at Paulistano Veterinary Center for the care, affection, and professionalism they showed my Teddynho.

These were very difficult and delicate days for us, and finding such a humane and caring team made all the difference. Teddy was very well cared for, always with great affection, attention, and respect.

I especially want to thank Rosana, an extremely loving, caring, and attentive person, who welcomed us with so much affection during such a difficult time. And to Dr. Amanda, a wonderful, attentive, and extremely competent professional, who demonstrated impeccable professionalism and a lot of love for what she does. My thanks also to Dr. Amanda's entire team, who cared for Teddy with so much affection and dedication.

It is very comforting to know that our animals are in the hands of people who truly care about them and their owners.

Thank you all so much for all the care you gave our Teddynho. ❤️🐾
I will certainly carry this experience and all this affection with me. I wholeheartedly recommend Paulistano Veterinary Center!

I have used the services at the Paulistano Veterinary Hospital several times, whether for routine check-ups, vaccinations, and more recently in an emergency situation with my dog.
They provide excellent service. From the reception to the veterinarians, everyone is very friendly and helpful.
I thank the team of veterinarians and assistants for the prompt service provided. I arrived at the hospital in the morning, around 7:30 am on 09/19/26, and we were immediately attended to. A team on standby attended to us, other doctors arrived... My Bulldog's health condition was quite serious, fortunately with a happy ending, but before that she was intubated and I was informed of everything that was happening and what they were doing to help her. She was hospitalized for 3 days, underwent several tests, and took the necessary medications. The doctors kept us informed with medical bulletins, and upon discharge I received instructions for continuing treatment at home, for follow-up appointments, and next steps. I would like to thank Dr. Iris, Dr. Lucas, Dr. Amanda, Dr. Davi, the ICU doctors and other doctors who cared for Maya, as well as the entire administrative and support staff.

I would like to express my sincerest gratitude to Dr. Letícia, nurse Carol, and the other nurse who assisted with Kitty's procedures. I would also like to commend Dr. Letícia for being so professional and dedicated; I felt extremely comfortable and was able to perfectly understand my little one's condition thanks to her meticulous explanation.

I am very satisfied with all your care, from online to in-person ❤️
They saved my puppy ❣️

Hello, I'm here to talk about my experience at this hospital.

Pleasant place, top-notch service.
Everyone was very attentive and the service was wonderful.
I took my father's kitten to have an eye ultrasound, she was seen by Dr. Rafael who was a sweetheart.

He was very patient with her, I loved it.

I highly recommend it.

I wasn't very happy with the service; we were kept waiting a long time. The doctor didn't even take the dog's temperature, and they ordered tests that cost 600 reais, even though clinics charge half that amount. The doctor prescribed a weak medication that I was already using. I won't be returning with my pet.

The professionals were incredibly attentive. From reception to exams and sample collection... in short, I felt safe entrusting my beloved feline to their care. Everything was very clean, and they even had tea and coffee for us. I highly recommend them. Oh, I also really enjoyed the consultations; the veterinarians are very good and explain everything with care and respect.

From the first appointment with Rosana to the veterinarians, everyone is incredibly careful. I'm treating my dog's cataracts at the clinic and I couldn't be more relieved that Maya is in excellent hands. I work in healthcare and their level of contamination control is essential. Congratulations to the whole team! ✨

Great experience! We treated tartar, gingivitis, and gastritis in my dog ​​Mike, and he's doing great. The teeth cleaning surgery was very quick, and he left the vet the same day, within a few hours. I thank Dr. Amanda, Dr. Davi, and all the vet staff, who also treated other dogs in my family. I highly recommend them!

I found this hospital through Google. My little Cookie had been coughing for over a year. From the moment she arrived, she was treated incredibly well. The veterinarians are fantastic; they did all the tests until they discovered her problem. A veterinarian, cardiologist, pulmonologist, and orthopedist all examined her. After medication, Cookie improved a lot. VIP treatment for a very fair price. I'm super satisfied! 😌 😌 😌 😌

From the first contact we received excellent service. We took my dog ​​to orthopedist Dr. Davi, and the service was sensational. They've definitely gained a customer, and I will always recommend them.

We received excellent service; it was an emergency, and they gave us all the necessary attention even after we informed them that they wouldn't be performing the surgery. After we left the clinic, they even contacted us to check if everything was alright and if my pet was okay. Excellent service, 10/10.

I want to express my heartfelt gratitude to the entire team that took care of Jade. 🙏🏻❤️ Thank God and thanks to you all, she's doing well!

A place that truly lives up to its purpose, with attentive and caring professionals who show so much love for animals. Besides all the care they gave Jade, they also showed great empathy and understanding towards me, even making payment easier for me.

I am very grateful for all the affection, care, and hospitality. Without a doubt, a place I wholeheartedly recommend! 🐾❤️

In a market full of qualified professionals, a company's greatest asset will always be how it treats its clients. I would like to express my deepest gratitude for all the support and empathy shown to my sister during a time of extreme vulnerability. She faces severe depression, and the compassionate support she received from you in dealing with the loss of her pet was fundamental in helping her get through this difficult time with dignity. Your humane service transforms lives.

I'm speechless about this team. Everyone is amazing, kind, and extremely professional. I'm so grateful for the compassion of manager Rosana, Dr. David, and nurse Carol Sette. You save lives every day! ♥️

The veterinarians are extremely attentive and polite! However, just one constructive criticism about the morning reception: the service sometimes leaves something to be desired. The receptionist has a somewhat difficult communication style. When I asked simple questions, I received repetitive and curt answers ('I don't have that information'), without any proactive attempt to verify or help. The service is "robotic" and gives the impression of unwillingness, which is a bit frustrating for someone trying to take care of their pet's health.

Impeccable service! Excellent professionals who took such good care of Barthô. ❤️
I would like to thank Rosana and Dr. Davi who cared for and supported him during the most difficult moment of his life. Thank you so much for the care, affection, and dedication in saving this life. ❤️

Wonderful and humane service, from reception to hospitalization. I want to thank you from the bottom of my heart for all the care, affection, and attention given to my Melzinha. In such a delicate and difficult moment for us, it was very important to find such a welcoming, attentive, and committed team.

Everyone was very careful and gave us security and confidence throughout the entire process. I am very grateful to each professional who cared for her with so much love and dedication. Thank you for all the care, affection, and respect shown to our family. ♥️🐾
I recommend the clinic without hesitation!

I would like to express my eternal gratitude to the hospital staff.
They took very good care of my little son.

I can't put into words how much the Paulistano team welcomed both my kitten and me.
I definitely can't express how important it was to see the entire team so dedicated to taking care of my little one, especially Dr. Millena, who didn't let go of my hand until the very last moment.
This is the most caring and loving place any pet could ever know. In every way!

Cappuccino and I are immensely grateful for everything!

I was very well attended to by Rosana, with great care and efficiency! They treated my kitten with love and dedication; he underwent surgery and was hospitalized. I can only thank the veterinarians, Dr. Davi and his team! Thank you all very much! From the Paulistano Hospital 🙏🏻

Impeccable veterinary hospital. The team is excellent, with special mention to Dr. Orlando, who, in addition to resolving each case with great competence, offers humane and welcoming support for both the pet and the family. Attentive, empathetic service without unnecessary bureaucracy.
A place that "humanizes" animals 👏👏👏👏 …

Thank you, Dr. Davi and Rosana!

You are taking care of dear cat Barthô with love and professionalism.
First-rate service! Excellent professionals who provide care with love, affection, and respect. Gratitude to all 🙏 Especially to Rosana, the manager, and Dr. Davi, the orthopedic surgeon. …
Thank you to everyone on the team for their kindness towards Barthô.

I want to express my gratitude for the extreme care and attention given to our little cat, Félix Tunico. Thanks to Dr. Davi and his team, our kitten received the correct diagnosis for his paw, underwent surgery, and is now recovering very well!

I also want to thank Rosana, who was extremely kind and welcomed us during a time of uncertainty and tension.

I highly recommend the clinic!!!!

They are high-quality professionals and, moreover, they are humane.

Unlike other places that take advantage of the fragile state of the animals and their owners!

Our most eternal gratitude for Félix!!! 💙

I would like to express my deepest gratitude to the entire team at the Paulistano Veterinary Hospital, who cared for our beloved Felix Tunico with true mastery after he broke all his little toes. In a world where medicine often becomes mechanical, you proved to us that love and technique can go hand in hand.

A special thank you to Dr. Davi, orthopedic surgeon. His competence restored Felix Tunico's health, but it was his humanity that calmed our hearts. Thank you for welcoming us and guiding us with such clarity, security, and empathy during a time of such uncertainty. I also thank the entire team that was by your side during the surgery.

To dear Rosana, our eternal gratitude. You not only attended to us; you carried us in your arms. Your kindness, patience, and welcoming attitude when dealing with the financial aspects was a true relief for our souls.

To Dr. Orlando, from the ICU: you are a sweetheart! In the most delicate moments, your affection was the light that brought us peace.
When cordiality and humanization begin at the top, the entire team reflects this care. This is not just managing a hospital; this is the mark of a true leader.
Dr. Davi, thank you so much for everything. You are simply wonderful!

Excellent veterinary hospital! My pet received excellent care from reception to hospitalization. The team is well-prepared: from receptionists and assistants to doctors, all were excellent. The veterinarians explained everything clearly and instilled a great sense of security during the consultation. Good equipment, quick diagnosis, and excellent treatment. I highly recommend it.

I want to express my gratitude to the entire Vet Paulistano team for the care they gave my Teddy. 🐶

Dr. Amanda was extremely attentive and careful, and Dr. Fábio, the gastroenterologist, was exceptional in managing the case, very thorough, clear, and confident in all his guidance and treatment. Dr. Lucas, who performed the ultrasound, was also incredible: very meticulous, careful, and kind.

In a moment of such concern, finding a team that combines competence, care, and humanity made all the difference. I felt very safe and supported throughout the entire process.

I can only thank them for the care and attention given to Teddy. I highly recommend them! ❤️

Please read what I write.
I never imagined that a veterinary hospital could make the word "human" so concrete. The team that awaits your pet is extremely competent and ready to listen to you and do the impossible for the well-being of your companion. Dr. Lucas, Dr. Iris, Lilian, Joaquim, and the entire team protected our Nina in an unimaginable way.

This will be the best decision you will ever make in your life!

We would like to express our satisfaction with the care we received at the Palistano Veterinary Hospital. From the very first moment, we were treated with kindness, respect, and professionalism. The team demonstrated constant concern for the well-being of our dog and also for the peace of mind of our family. We especially appreciate the way they explained each stage of the treatment and the attentive follow-up. Our sincere thanks to the entire team for their care and empathy.

The service takes too long, the assessment during the consultation wasn't accurate, I was embarrassed at reception when I was leaving, a woman yelled from her desk asking if I didn't have anything to settle… but it was a follow-up appointment; even so, the woman asked about medication that hadn't been administered either. In short, I won't go back, I don't recommend it. It's not worth it! Look for another place to take your pet. Whenever you find something on Google, check Reclame Aqui (Brazilian consumer complaint website) and the reviews that IA (a Brazilian consumer review website) does; I only saw negative things about this clinic, but it was only after going and experiencing it firsthand that I realized this. The consultation is cheap, but the exams aren't… I spent over $700… so it wasn't free…

We are very sorry about your feedback. We searched our system for your registration but found no record or contact information under your name. If you have been in contact with us, we would very much like to understand what happened. Please get in touch so we can discuss and clarify the situation.

I arrived with my dog ​​who was ill due to the heat. The clinic owner called my wife and me in and said the case was "serious." However, he hadn't done any tests to confirm this. To make matters worse, they intubated my dog ​​without my authorization, administered medication without our consent, and, incredibly, charged almost 3,000 reais for the unauthorized services. I do not recommend them!!!

I took my 14-year-old Shih Tzu with heart problems, he stayed in the ICU for 2 days, then went to the ward. I only have praise for the entire team, veterinarians, nurses, interns, they are great, caring and attentive to animals. Rosana is an excellent person, she gives us strength.

My Shih Tzu arrived there unable to walk, with a purple mouth, and after 4 days he returned home, well. We continued the treatment, I highly recommend the hospital.

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

I have a lot of affection and trust in this clinic! I really like the services and, especially, the care. The whole team is very helpful, attentive, and careful.

I always treat my dogs there: Tereza, Joaquim, and Jade. Tereza underwent surgery, and I was very happy with all the care and follow-up in the post-operative period. Joaquim was my first patient at the clinic and has already undergone several treatments, always with excellent results and great care.

I want to especially thank Rosana, who is extremely attentive and helpful, an excellent professional, and Dr. David, the surgeon, for his professionalism and dedication.

I am very grateful for all the care they have always shown my pets. I recommend the clinic without hesitation! 🐶❤️

Excellent service! I took my cat to the Paulista Veterinary Clinic and we were very well received from the start. The veterinarian was extremely attentive, careful, and gave me all the possible guidance, explaining everything very clearly and calmly.

My cat was very well treated and returned home feeling great, more active, hungry, and eating normally, which made me much more relaxed.

I can only thank the veterinarian and the entire team for their care, attention, and affection for him. Thank you so much! I highly recommend them! 🐱❤️
hospital with excellent facilities and professionals.
Excellent, I'm speechless at the service and welcome, the hospital is well-organized, it saved my dog's life, I can only express my gratitude.

I am very grateful to the team and to Rosana. Excellent professionals, very attentive and caring! We know how difficult it is nowadays to find professionals who love their profession, and the staff there have plenty of that! My kitten was hospitalized there, and even while I was traveling, thanks to the photos and updates they always gave us, I was able to stay calm knowing she was in good hands. I highly recommend them, thank you!
A welcoming, empathetic, and professional service.

My dog ​​Ully, a Lhasa Apso, needed to be hospitalized in the ICU for 3 days, and they were very attentive and careful. They performed all the necessary tests. The veterinary team is excellent and very professional. There was an on-call service where daily updates were given. The attendants and nurses were very helpful and caring.

Excellence in emergency care.
God bless these competent professionals who save our little animal angels. 🙏 …
Excellent

Excellent in everything. A ureterotomy was performed, removing a kidney stone from the ureter of my cat's kidney. From the contact on WhatsApp, they were attentive, where I asked MANY questions and all were always very well answered, with very explanatory audios and texts, without delay in service. And when the question was very complex, the reception would forward it to a doctor to answer in more detail. This already gave me a lot of confidence to bring Sofia here.
In person, it was great too, Dr. Carol immediately picked her up and petted her while explaining the process to me, and Sofia felt very comfortable from the beginning with this warm welcome. Dr. Gabriel was also very helpful in explaining the entire surgical procedure. The other doctors were also incredible, always attentive and very detailed in their explanations. She would be hospitalized for 4 days and in the ICU for 1 day. But due to the good progress, she was released 1 day earlier and I received a refund for this hospitalization that was not necessary. This also made me very satisfied. I also received support via WhatsApp throughout her entire hospitalization. She received two daily updates with audio and video messages about her condition. I have no complaints. The team was excellent, from reception to nurses and doctors.

Attentive, caring, and fond of animals. Fair prices. The reception staff, cleaning staff, Dr. Andrea (echocardiogram), Dr. Giovana, nurses, and Dr. Gabriel are all excellent in every way. And very ethical. They also have good parking space. Congratulations!
They were very attentive and treated us with great care.

It was great!

You are very attentive.

I want to express my special gratitude to Dr. Orlando. I wish all animals the good fortune to find people like him.

For us, it was a pleasure to have had the opportunity to be cared for by such qualified professionals who look after our animals with so much love and satisfaction. They are undoubtedly the best professionals, dedicated, caring, and with a lot of love for what they do. My sincere congratulations to the entire team.
I received excellent care; the veterinarian Geovana was wonderful, welcoming, and efficient.
Good professionals.
Amazing from the very first appointment, super fast, very attentive professionals with my kitten, exams, treatments... I highly recommend them!!!

I really like the team at Paulistano. I had surgery done there for one of my cats, she was very well treated and cared for, and right now I'm treating another cat for cystitis.

They are very professional and attentive, both to the owners and the animals.

The hospital boasts excellent infrastructure and a fantastic team! You can get many types of exams and surgeries done, even the most complex ones. Dr. Davi is the kind of veterinarian you can tell truly loves animals and is always willing to help in the best way possible! They took care of my dog ​​Miu Miu with so much affection and love! A big thank you to the wonderful team of veterinarians! I highly recommend them to everyone!
My Kadu underwent a neutering and teeth cleaning procedure; the service was impeccable, and the staff was very kind and helpful.
The compassionate care from all the doctors and staff was exceptional. I am extremely grateful for everything.
Excellent team, sensational service. They work with love, it's on another level. Thank you.
Excellent service, very attentive and careful staff.
Excellent professionals.

We have complete confidence in the Paulistano Veterinary Hospital. From the manager Rosana, who is an excellent professional, to the super attentive and informative veterinarians, I have absolutely no complaints. The clinic stands out and they work to ensure the best possible service for both pet owners and their pets. They did a great job taking care of my cats, and that's why I trust the clinic so much and recommend it without hesitation. Thank you very much for all the attention and service.

I would like to congratulate everyone at the Paulistano Veterinary Hospital for their professionalism, competence, and excellent service, from the cleaning staff to the medical team. And to top it off, they offer fair prices and accessible conditions for any procedure. We would like to express our gratitude and wish much success to all mentioned here. Congratulations!!!

Cleaning staff,
Lilian (receptionist),
Isabela (receptionist),
Rosana (manager),
Orlando (veterinarian),
Amanda (veterinarian),
Carol (nurse),
Rafael (surgeon),
Bigal (anesthesiologist), and others...

Unfortunately, my experience was not good. The main problem with the clinic is communication. At different times, I noticed that the professionals seemed unsure of the information they were providing, which compromised my confidence in the service. In addition, I encountered disorganization and delays throughout the entire process.
To pick up my cat from the hospital, I waited about 3 hours until she was delivered. Since I needed to take her to a trusted veterinarian in another city, I also faced a trip of approximately 1 hour and 20 minutes. This delay only delayed the start of the treatment she really needed. During this period, I also had the impression that the staff insisted on convincing me to keep her hospitalized, even after I had already decided to pick her up.

The tests had already been paid for, but since I picked up my cat before medical discharge and the results were not yet ready, I requested a document or statement proving that the services and tests had been performed, to ensure that the results would be sent later. I only received the PDFs of the tests and services provided, without the invoice for the payments made. When the results were ready, the clinic chose to send only a link, instead of the PDF files. It may seem like a detail, but I consider this a lack of professionalism and courtesy, especially in a healthcare company, where organization, transparency, and ease of access to documentation are fundamental.

The most frustrating point is that, after taking her to my trusted veterinarian, he was the one who identified what my cat really had and conducted the appropriate treatment. Given the whole experience, I was left with the impression that there was a greater concern in indicating surgical procedures than in carrying out a more careful clinical investigation.

The clinic is beautiful and gives a good impression, but unfortunately, the quality of care did not meet expectations. I hope these points will be reviewed, as clear communication, organization, transparency, and respect for the owner's decisions make all the difference at such a delicate time.

[Update:] After picking up my cat from the clinic, she was seen by my trusted veterinarian, who immediately started the appropriate medication treatment. Fortunately, she didn't need to stay in the hospital, was discharged the same day, and went home. Since then, she has responded very well to treatment, has resumed bowel movements naturally, and did not need the surgery that, during the consultation at this clinic, was repeatedly emphasized as the recommended course of action.
This reinforced my concern, as the initially suggested course of action was a surgical procedure. Given the diagnosis and treatment that effectively resolved the problem, I became convinced that surgery was not necessary and would have subjected my cat to an invasive procedure. My concern was even greater because the veterinarian herself informed me that it was a surgery with a very delicate post-operative period and many risks.

Another point that I consider relevant is the interpretation of imaging exams. In my opinion, a clinic of this size should have a specialist in diagnostic imaging to interpret X-ray exams more quickly, especially in emergency situations, instead of relying on telemedicine or concentrating this step in a workflow that ends up delaying the definition of the course of action.
Later, I heard that it's "not common" to receive an X-ray report quickly. However, at the clinic where my cat has always been treated, the exam was evaluated and reported on by a specialist right away, precisely because it was an emergency. This report was crucial for her to receive the correct diagnosis and appropriate treatment immediately.

I do not recommend the clinic.

Attentive staff, nice environment, pleasing to the eye, but still far from an acceptable "hospital" standard. It's more like a clinic focused on profit, great for selling common procedures including exams, but don't expect anything beyond that. Zero trust. I do not recommend it.

Organization exists but is poor, critical thinking is questionable, shift changes take more than 30 minutes (avoid these times, nothing works), priority is given to those with appointments, you may be left waiting without understanding anything, conflicting information, lack of control, failed palliative attempts, and average service. For those who receive good service, such as vaccinations or routine procedures, they are always asked to give a good rating; just look at the other reviews.

Don't be fooled, always question and stay informed, especially in the reviews here; there are only "bad customers".

Wonderful service from all the doctors and staff, we are very grateful.

Erick / Eliana (Felicio)

Excellent clinic, my kitten ended up developing kidney disease and there couldn't have been a better clinic to start the "treatment". Dr. Gabriel is an excellent doctor, he explains everything very well and gives you a confidence beyond what I can explain. Lulu's Hospital forever.

Paulistano is a welcoming, family-friendly environment; everyone from the reception to the medical staff is incredible 🥰
Fast service at a fair price. Highly qualified professionals 🩷 …
Excellent experience, the professionals were very attentive and careful with my puppy, and they explained clearly how I should medicate and care for her. I recommend them!
Wonderful hospital, excellent service and amazing doctors.
Excellent service and great professionals!

I had a 5-star experience; all the doctors are extremely attentive, the nurses are careful and kind, and the reception area is always clean and the reception staff are super welcoming. They have coffee/tea, which shows that the hospital treats everyone very well.

Wonderful hospital, humane care, I've been taking my pets there for years and wouldn't trade it for any other place.
I would like to thank Dr. David and his entire team who always treat everyone with great care and respect, giving us the security and comfort to treat our four-legged children and all types of animals.
Gratitude for everything and so much more.

Incredible experience, the best hospital ever! My dog ​​was neutered at the Paulistano Hospital and the next day he was already fully recovered and the healing process was perfect.
In addition, I would like to thank the team for the work done with dedication and love for our pets.

I chose this hospital because of the good Google reviews, but my experience was completely different from what I expected.

I took my cat there after a vomiting episode in the early hours of Saturday morning. The first thing that caught my attention was discovering that, despite being a 24-hour hospital, it doesn't perform tests at any time. So, the on-call veterinarian only medicated her and scheduled the tests for the next day.

Tramadol, dipyrone, and ondansetron were administered. After this medication, my cat began to salivate excessively and showed signs of disorientation, remaining so until the following morning.

I returned the next day for the tests and reported this entire history. After evaluating the results, I was informed that she had a serious kidney condition and that hospitalization was strongly recommended.

I decided to have her admitted. However, during the first day of hospitalization, I didn't notice any improvement. When I visited her that night, she was visibly worse than when she had been admitted and was again salivating. When I questioned the team, I received contradictory information: one doctor stated that the same medication that had previously caused a reaction had been administered, while a nurse reported that this had not occurred. The impression was one of a lack of coordination and control over the procedures performed.

Only after I expressed my dissatisfaction were other treatments initiated, such as the administration of vitamins and intravenous medications. Even so, the team continued to attribute the main problem to the kidneys, despite my questions about a possible ingestion of something toxic and about intestinal inflammation that was evident in the tests.

On Monday, a new veterinarian took over the case and informed me that the origin of the condition was precisely this intestinal inflammation—the same one I had previously questioned—while the kidney problem was a chronic issue and not the main cause of hospitalization.

This led me to conclude that the underlying problem had not been adequately treated from the beginning. Furthermore, the failure in the communication of information between shifts became evident, since with each change of team I had to repeat the entire history and received different interpretations of the case.

Unfortunately, my experience was marred by communication failures, a lack of alignment between the professionals, and a management style that did not inspire confidence regarding my cat's treatment.

I do not recommend them and will not return.

About a month and a half ago, I took my cat to this clinic for a consultation and tests due to changes in her health. An abdominal ultrasound was performed, the report of which clearly stated:

"Ultrasound images suggestive of nephropathy/senility. Correlation with laboratory tests is recommended."

At the time, I was only informed that the changes found were "normal for her age," and despite the express recommendation in the report itself for laboratory tests, no blood tests were requested, nor was I advised on the need for a more in-depth investigation of renal function.

My cat received a large quantity of medication to take home and was discharged without the ultrasound findings being properly correlated with complementary tests, as recommended by the veterinarian responsible for the report.

Recently, due to a significant worsening of her clinical condition, I sought another veterinarian. It was then found that there are important changes that require proper investigation and treatment, including blood tests to assess renal function and overall health.

Today, my cat is in a delicate situation: she has lost weight, has difficulty walking, is hospitalized, and has experienced a considerable decline in her quality of life. As her owner, I am extremely concerned that the recommendation in the report was neither followed nor even mentioned during the consultation, which may have delayed the diagnosis and the start of appropriate treatment.

I understand that not every problem can be predicted or avoided, but I consider it serious that a recommendation expressed in a complementary examination was ignored, without any guidance on the importance of laboratory tests for monitoring the situation.

I register here my deep dissatisfaction with the handling of the case and hope that the clinic will review its communication and follow-up protocols so that other animals and owners do not go through the same situation.

The impression given is that they only want money, nothing more.
